desc:
Welcome to Giant Beanstalk Obby! An exciting and new obstacle course in a fairy tale world. Some stages are easy while others maybe prove to be difficult. 

📅 Updates:
-Premium Players now get +50% Jelly Beans!
-Playing with Friends gives you +25% Jelly Beans per Friend!
-Magic Beans that allow you to skip stages!
-100 NEW CASTLE STAGES for a total of 600 stages!

Be warned... The Castle Stages are MUCH more difficult!!

Leave a Like 👍 and Favorite ⭐ for more updates!

🌎 Join the group "ChillBlox Games" for 3 FREE Magic Skip Stage Bean! Please leave any Comments/Feedback on the Group Page or message the Group Owner.

💾 Your progress autosaves!
